description: Checks whether specific domain names are free to register, for exact domains such as brightfield.com or brightfield.io. Up to 50 a call. Each result has domain, available (true, false or null), status (available, taken or unknown), checked_at, confirmed, by (registry, registrar, dns, dns_only or confirming) and confirmation; confirmed=false means the answer came from DNS and is still being confirmed. confirmation says how firm the answer is: registry, registrar, dns_delegated, dns_pending, dns_only (free on DNS, and nothing else can confirm it on that ending) or none. A free domain has price (first_year, renews, min_years, currency USD) and buy_url, a link to register that domain at a registrar. A taken domain has registrar, registered and expires when the registry publishes them. For the first 3 taken domains, alternatives lists up to 3 domains with the same name on other endings that were free when checked, each with price and buy_url.
name: check_domains
title: Check domains
